instructions: Complete the summary below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.
stem_block:
A reef that is already living in tomorrow's sea

Maug's unusual chemistry comes from its geology. Magma still lies beneath the seafloor and, along the (36) ........ of the caldera, drives shallow vents that release carbon dioxide straight into the water beside a living reef. A visiting team fixed recording instruments in place, while divers underwater marked fresh growth on the corals with (37) ........ and collected material to be examined later. Reef scientists' wider worry is that corals will lose the contest for space, and that complex reef habitat will gradually give way to simpler (38) ........ . A second piece of research, published in the journal (39) ........ , looked at what happens inside the coral skeletons rather than on the seafloor surface. Because these changes resemble what reefs elsewhere may meet before this century ends, the island is now studied as a (40) ........ for the rest of the ocean.

items.prompt: Magma still lies beneath the seafloor and, along the (36) ........ of the caldera, drives shallow vents that release carbon dioxide straight into the water beside a living reef.
items.evidence: Magma still sits beneath the seafloor, and along the inner shoreline of the caldera it drives shallow vents that continuously release carbon dioxide gas directly into the water beside a living coral reef, a combination that is extremely rare anywhere on Earth.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says magma beneath the seafloor drives shallow vents along the inner shoreline of the caldera; so the answer is 'inner shoreline'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Maug is what is left of a volcano that fell in on itself, so that three small islands now sit in a ring around a drowned (36) ........ .
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Maug is what remains of a volcano that collapsed long ago, leaving three small islands arranged in a rough circle around a flooded caldera.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevabin kendisi yerlesik bir jeoloji terimi: cokmus bir yanardagin halka bicimli cukuru 'caldera' diye anilir ve ozetin kendisi bu tanimi ('a volcano that fell in on itself ... three small islands in a ring') veriyor; model uc turda da yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Tanimi cikarmak boslugu yanitlanamaz yapar, birakmak terimi verir. E6 onerisi: B/2'nin oteki ayrintisi - uc adanin sayisi ya da adalarin dizilisi yerine yanardagin cokme zamani.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru B/2'ye capaliydi ve cevap yerlesik bir jeoloji terimiydi ('caldera'); ozet cumlesi terimin tanimini veriyordu. Yeni yuva B/2'ye hic degmiyor: kanit B/3'e, bacalarin kaldera icinde tam olarak nerede siralandigi ayrintisina tasindi. Konum bilgisi yalniz metinden okunur, terim bilgisinden cikmaz.

items.prompt: A visiting team fixed recording instruments in place, while divers underwater marked fresh growth on the corals with (37) ........ and collected material to be examined later.
items.evidence: The team deployed instruments to continuously record temperature, light, the partial pressure of carbon dioxide, seawater pH and water currents, while divers collected coral cores, applied dye to mark new growth, and used funnels to capture bubbles of gas escaping from the vents for laboratory analysis.
items.explanation: Paragraph D states that divers applied dye to mark new growth; since the gap asks what this marking was done with, the answer is 'dye'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('dye / stains / dye' verdi; boyama maddesi olarak stain ile dye aynı şeyi adlandırıyor).
items.review_note: E5 / 8. calistirma: dokunulmadi. Model dye / stains / dye verdi, yani 3 turun 2'sinde puan alirdi. Bas ad cumlenin anlamsal rolunce zorunlu: 'yeni buyumeyi ___ ile isaretlediler' cercevesinde bir isaretleme maddesi okunur ve D/2'de o maddenin adi zaten tek. Cerceveyi gevsetmek boslugu tags/markers gibi pasajda bulunmayan adaylara acar, yani soruyu yanitlanamaz yapar. 🔴 E7 ayrica olcmeli.

items.prompt: Reef scientists' wider worry is that corals will lose the contest for space, and that complex reef habitat will gradually give way to simpler (38) ........ .
items.evidence: This pattern matches a broader concern among reef scientists: that as oceans acidify, algae may increasingly outcompete corals for space, gradually replacing complex reef habitat with simpler algal turf.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says reef scientists fear that algae will outcompete corals for space, gradually replacing complex reef habitat with simpler algal turf; so the answer is 'algal turf'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: Their readings show that the water closest to the openings is slightly more acidic than the rest of the reef, and that the seabed there is taken over by (38) ........ instead of healthy coral.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: Immediately around the vents, weedy algae tend to dominate the seafloor, while reefs only a short distance away, in less acidified water, remain visibly healthier and more coral-dominated.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevap iki yonden sizdiriyor: asitlenen suda saglikli mercanin yerini yosunun almasi iklim habercilerinin en cok tekrarladigi oruntudur ve kabul listesi 'algae' sozcugunu tek basina kabul ediyor; model uc turda da 'algae' yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Niteleyiciyi ('weedy') zorunlu kilmak icin kabul listesini daraltmak gerekir, o da korunan bir alan. E6 onerisi: F/2'nin karsilastirma yarisi - bacalardan biraz uzaktaki mercanin gorunur bicimde saglikli kalmasi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru F/2'ye capaliydi; cevap ('weedy algae') hem iklim habercileri tarafindan surekli tekrarlanan bir oruntuydu hem de kabul listesi 'algae' sozcugunu tek basina kabul ediyordu. Yeni yuva F/2'ye hic degmiyor: kanit F/3'e, arastirmacilarin genel kaygisini anlatan cumleye tasindi ve cerceveden 'algae' sozcugu bilerek cikarildi, boylece bosluk artik yakin bir es anlamliyi cagirmiyor. Kabul listesi tek bicime indirilmedi, bastan tek bicimli yazildi.

items.prompt: A second piece of research, published in the journal (39) ........ , looked at what happens inside the coral skeletons rather than on the seafloor surface.
items.evidence: A related study of the Maug reef, published separately in the journal PLOS ONE, focused on what happens inside coral skeletons rather than on the seafloor surface.
items.explanation: Paragraph G says a related study of the Maug reef was published in the journal PLOS ONE and looked inside coral skeletons rather than at the seafloor surface; so the answer is 'PLOS ONE'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: A second piece of research found that minute organisms bore into the skeletons far more heavily in this water, speeding up (39) ........ and weakening the reef from the inside.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: It found that in the naturally acidified water near the vents, microscopic boring organisms colonised coral skeletons more heavily, accelerating a process called bioerosion in which the skeleton is weakened and broken down from within.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cevabin kendisi yerlesik bir deniz biyolojisi terimi ve ozet onun tanimini veriyor: 'minute organisms bore into the skeletons ... weakening the reef from the inside' zaten bioerosion'un sozluk karsiligidir; model uc turda da yazdi (3/3 PUAN). Tanimi cikarinca bosluk yanitlanamaz hale geliyor. E6 onerisi: G/2'nin nicel yarisi - oyucu canlilarin bu suda ne kadar daha yogun yerlestigi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru G/2'ye capaliydi ve cevap yerlesik bir deniz biyolojisi terimiydi ('bioerosion'); ozet cumlesi terimin sozluk tanimini veriyordu. Yeni yuva G/2'ye hic degmiyor: kanit G/1'e, ikinci calismanin yayimlandigi derginin adina tasindi. Dergi adi keyfi bir kunye bilgisi; tanimdan turetilemez.

items.prompt: Because these changes resemble what reefs elsewhere may meet before this century ends, the island is now studied as a (40) ........ for the rest of the ocean.
items.evidence: For that reason, scientists regard the island less as a curiosity than as an early warning system, showing in the present what the consequences of a warmer, more acidic ocean could look like almost everywhere else.
items.explanation: Paragraph H says that scientists regard the island as an early warning system, showing in the present what a warmer, more acidic ocean could look like elsewhere; the answer is therefore 'warning system'.
